data.text: Before we choose our catches, how about we each agree to take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 each, leaving 50 tons to double back to 100 by next month. If we keep that up, we can all earn steadily without depleting the lake. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone kept the agreement and discuss any problems before the next round. John, would you agree to a 10-ton limit?
